headline: Ducks rookie dons No. 95, channels Lightning McQueen in NHL debut
description: After a draft night trip to Disneyland to meet Lightning McQueen, the "Cars" synergy came full circle for the Ducks rookie's NHL debut.
take:
Per ESPN, Ducks rookie Roger McQueen wore No. 95 and channeled Lightning McQueen in his NHL debut, a "Cars" tie-in that came full circle after a draft night trip to Disneyland to meet the character.

The on-ice numbers are a one-game sample, so treat them lightly. McQueen played 11.43 minutes without a point, and his own expected goals were 0.13, so he finished 0.13 below expected. Anaheim controlled only 32.95 percent of the 5-on-5 expected goals with him out there, and the team's share was 14.88 points better without him. That is a quiet, sheltered debut, nothing more. For fantasy purposes, he has no value yet at this usage. The more useful read is on Anaheim. The Ducks sit at 4-2-0, but their expected goals share is 48.6 percent (46 percent at 5-on-5), so they have been slightly outplayed. Two things are carrying them: they are 1.3 goals above expected, and their goaltending has saved 2.8 goals above expected so far this season. Both can fade, which is why the record looks better than the underlying play.
